name: Member savings balance lookup
description: Look up a credit-union member in the MeridianCore servicing console and return the current balance and status of their Regular Savings account.

outputs.description: Current Balance shown for the Regular Savings account

strategies.rationale: the control is identified by its visible label, which is what the operator clicks to clear the screen

params.text: Acknowledge and Continue

strategies.rationale: visible-text fallback if the role is reported differently

recovery_rules.description: A one-time System Notice interstitial appears the first time Member Servicing is opened after sign-on, warning about a scheduled maintenance window. It is cleared by clicking the 'Acknowledge and Continue' button, after which the Member Servicing lookup screen appears normally. It does not reappear later in the same session.

provenance.goal: Sign on to the MeridianCore servicing console, open Member Servicing, look up the member whose number is given by the member_id input, and read that member's Regular Savings account: its current balance and its status. Also read the member's name from the member record.
provenance.notes: dropped the step that dismissed the interstitial ('Dismiss the system notice to proceed to Member Servicing'); it is covered by a recovery rule, which fires whenever the screen appears
